candidates.description: This vector represents entities, characters, and proper nouns associated with the Harry Potter universe.
This vector represents fantasy lore and magical elements, including spellcasters, mythical creatures, and sorcery.
This feature vector represents concepts of similarity, comparison, and contrast between entities or ideas.
This feature vector represents action verbs related to entering, leaving, or interacting with locations and encounters.
This vector represents verbs and related terms denoting verbal communication, argumentation, or reasoning.
This vector represents approximate degree, qualification, or similarity modifiers used to soften or qualify statements.
This feature vector represents abstract internal emotional states, hidden knowledge, and mystical concepts.
This vector represents narrative genres and entertainment media focused on storytelling and emotional engagement.
This vector represents verbs and nouns related to basic human emotions, desires, and life experiences.
This vector represents the concept of expressing critical, artistic, or evaluative judgments about actions, characters, or subjects.
